stated_rule: A config is COMPLIANT if and only if the host is all lowercase, port is an integer between 1 and 65535, retries is an integer between 1 and 5, mode is exactly "http" or "grpc", and tls is an object with a boolean "enabled" and a lowercase string "cert".

A config is compliant iff host is a lowercase string, port is an integer 1-65535, retries is an integer 1-5, mode is "http" or "grpc", and tls is an object with enabled boolean and cert lowercase string.
